confidence_notes: Restaurant and café anchors (meal, cappuccino, beer, cocktail, wine) are drawn from secondary aggregated sources (Numbeo-based listings, CityCost, Expatica) and Melbourne/Sydney bar guides adjusted down for Cairns. Restaurant meal figures are the strongest. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship, with Cairns set below Melbourne/Sydney bar levels. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for July, which is peak dry season in Cairns; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX observation could not be verified from rba.gov.au: searches returned only third-party reports, including a 4pm Sydney reference of about 0.6976 for 2026-11-03, which is cited here as the source rate. The as_of_date and source_rate should be checked against the RBA F11 daily series before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Australian tourist-hub cities outside Sydney and Melbourne, with Cairns food and drink prices set below Brisbane and Gold Coast levels, and accommodation pricing reflecting July peak-season demand.
